title: Kusanagi Nene — Messenger Of Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Today's the day we head to SEKAI to start planning our strategy...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How we can save Phoenix Wonderland as Emu would like while not having to make some deal with another company.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But a real business plan might be pretty challenging...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This park may very well be struggling financially, but it would be all for naught if the park ended up folding by operating the way it has been...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So we need a way to make sure Phoenix Wonderland can stay afloat while maintaining its current image...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We have to do everything we can for Emu's sake too...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Emu also mentioned that she'll come over here once school was over too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think Tsukasa even told her to wait outside by the gate, but I'm sure she'll just barge in like always.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A message? Who could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, it's Hoshino...
<I'd like to practice with you again...>)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We made some progress with Emu, and I'd like to pay her back for what she did for me the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<I should be free the day after tomorrow and during the next holiday.>
And send...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, you're still in your classroom.
It's almost time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I know. Just give me a...
I'm heeere!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that has to be...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
None other than Emu.
She's already here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? But I don't see anyone matching her description by the school gate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may just be that she wants to greet everyone or everything she comes across.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, but that means... What do we do if she gets caught by a teacher?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good question. However, we should be fine. Emu should only be going to one of two places.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? One of two?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She visits our school fairly often, but she only knows where your class is along with Tsukasa's.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? Wait, doesn't she know where your class is too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She does. But since my class is right next to Tsukasa's, there's no logical reason for her to go there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shall we head over to Tsukasa's class, while keeping an eye out for her in the meantime?
Kamiyama High School - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everything was pretty quiet on the way over here, so where could she have gone?)

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's you lot.
Not going home yet?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A teacher?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear... This may be bad, but let's observe a bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh! There's Emu hiding behind Tsukasa under a desk.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But the teacher hasn't noticed her yet, I don't think. If Tsukasa can keep them busy somehow and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wh-What are you doing, Emu?! Tsukasa was actually doing a good job...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may need to step in here. Nene, if you don't mind coming over here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can stay out of sight here and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you plan on doing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Just follow my lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Follow your lead...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fight! Check it out! The baseball team's really going at each other's throats!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, okay. Now I get it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Someone! Get a teacher!

rows.Speaker: Male Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
A fight?! We need to stop them!
Tenma, go home! Now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And... They're gone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You could've told me you were going to do that, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? But you did splendidly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe you came up with the best line possible there, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Hehehe. That was sooo much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Fun?! Do you even know how to play hide and seek?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh geez...
Those two must be in a good mood if they're being this loud.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this is how things should be...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, shall we head over to SEKAI with them before a teacher finds us out?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Sounds good.
